reviewed_exclusions.reason: Local report published November 9 at 12:09 PM Eastern reports sale of five remaining Winn-Dixie stores in Georgia to Food Lion; stores remain open until later brief conversions and are expected to reopen mid-December. Not a sole community grocery loss or confirmed immediate major food-access interruption.
November 9 06:00 Eastern feature on Detroit co-op financial challenges; not a newly announced sudden closure, and published before the hourly search window.
Provider update dated October 27 says Provo/Oakley/Coalville remain open and Heber site to close mid-November; pre-existing notice, no new immediate disruption.
Eau Claire pop-up distributions for remainder of 2026 were canceled in report dated November 3, updated November 6, already known to prior checks; not an in-window development.
Hawaii SNAP application/interview wait-time notice does not establish a newly dated same-hour SNAP/WIC benefit interruption.
General mobile pantry schedule does not identify a newly confirmed emergency cancellation.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Omitted donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine program promotion, generic inflation, old grocery fires, old pantry shutdowns, 2025 SNAP shutdown coverage, and duplicate historical items.
coverage_notes.assessment: No newly verified high-value qualifying signal between the previous completed checkpoint and this run. Search results were heavily dominated by historical events and incidental 2026 news. Bounded national recall cannot establish nationwide completeness; emerging local notices may be delayed in indexing.
